findings_carried.title: YAML parse errors echo registry source lines into n8n error surfaces
findings_carried.description: The route-resolution catch wraps (error as Error).message verbatim. Verified empirically that the yaml package's parse-error messages embed the offending source line with a caret (e.g. a malformed 'profile_name: <value>: oops' line is reproduced in full). That message propagates via NodeOperationError to n8n execution error output and, when continueOnFail is enabled, into the item's json.error field, where downstream nodes could forward it onto the bus.
findings_carried.impact: A malformed agents-registry.yaml can leak the broken line's content — potentially a profile name that registry.ts:15-17 documents as never leaving the boundary — into workflow-visible error data. Likelihood is low (requires a syntactically broken operator-managed file) and exposure is bounded to roughly one line, but it contradicts the stated non-exposure invariant.
findings_carried.required_fix: In the catch at Bloodbank.node.ts:290-296, sanitize parser errors before wrapping: for YAMLParseError use only the reason and position (e.g. message up to the first newline, or linePos-derived 'at line X, column Y') and never the source snippet; add a publisher-node test asserting a malformed registry with a profile-name line produces an error message that does not contain that line's content.

findings_carried.title: Introduced ajv 8.17.1 is inside the affected range of advisory GHSA-2g4f-4pwh-qvx6
findings_carried.description: npm audit --omit=dev reports one moderate production advisory introduced by this range: ajv ReDoS when using the $data option (fixed in 8.20.0). The vulnerable condition is not present here — src/nats.ts:95 constructs Ajv2020 without $data and every validated schema is a first-party document committed under schemas/ and embedded by codegen, so no attacker-controlled schema or $data reference can reach the compiler.
findings_carried.impact: No exploitable path in this usage; the residual risk is future code enabling $data or validating untrusted schemas against this pinned version, and audit noise gating other dependency work.
findings_carried.required_fix: Bump the ajv pin to ^8.20.0 (or the latest 8.x) and regenerate package-lock.json via npm install ajv@^8.20.0 in a follow-up; no code change is required.
